label: Content to Campaign
description: The nine-step campaign journey the Marketing Studio shows. Telemetry stamps a stage id from this pack so cost, latency and escalations can be reported by business step rather than by agent internals.

stages.label: Intake
stages.description: Request captured, validated and completeness-checked; gaps raised back to the requester.

stages.label: Audience and offer
stages.description: Personas, segment applicability, value proposition and sourced proof points.

stages.label: Asset plan
stages.description: Reuse, adapt or create decisions per asset, content outlines and the delivery calendar.

stages.label: Drafting
stages.description: Flagship long-form draft, then the derivative fan-out it unlocks.

stages.label: Review
stages.description: Reviewer feedback rounds, conflict resolution and the content-confirmed human gate.

stages.label: Packaging
stages.description: Confirmed assets assembled into the Campaign-in-a-Box manifest with content hashes.

stages.label: Compliance
stages.description: Deterministic rule checks plus the contextual compliance pass over the packaged set.

stages.label: Grammar QA
stages.description: Per-asset language review tasks worked by human reviewers.

stages.label: Sign-off
stages.description: Marketing Lead package decision; approval locks the box.
